# Incident report: checkout failures (2026-11-05)

## Summary
From ~14:03 UTC, a share of checkouts failed. checkout-web 5xx peaked at 17.6% and payments-api error rate at 18.3%, with payments p99 latency at 3150 ms (baseline ~420 ms). The cause was feature flag change **flg_2210**, which ramped `tax_engine_v2` from 10% to 100% in payments-api at 14:02 UTC. TaxEngineV2 calls to tax-service `/v2/quote` timed out, so payments `/charge` returned 502s. We reduced the flag back to 10% at ~14:29 UTC. Error rates returned to baseline (checkout-web 0.4%, payments-api 0.3%) and payments p99 to 450 ms.

## Severity
SEV1. Checkout requests failed for well over 10% of traffic (payments-api error rate 18.3%, checkout-web 5xx 17.6%).

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:15: cfg_0412 raised tax-service DB connection pool 50 -> 80 (routine; no matching errors, judged unrelated).
- 13:41: dep_7781 deployed payments-api v2.13.4 -> v2.14.0 (grpc-java bump, log formatting). Error rate flat for 20+ minutes afterwards, so ruled out.
- 14:02: flg_2210 ramped tax_engine_v2 10% -> 100%. First TaxEngineV2 timeouts logged at 14:02:31. payments-api error rate and p99 step up at 14:02–14:03.
- 14:03: alert alt_31: payments-api p99 > 2000 ms. tax-service logs "p99 3021ms; shedding load."
- 14:05: dep_7790 deployed search-api v5.2.0 -> v5.2.1. search-api p99 rose modestly (310 -> 430 ms, then 330 ms) with no error logs. Not on the checkout failure path; ruled out as the cause.
- 14:06: alert alt_32: checkout-web 5xx > 5%.
- 14:08: tax-service logs "worker pool exhausted."
- 14:09: alert alt_33: search-api p95 > 400 ms (warning).
- 14:21: incident response started.
- 14:29: mitigation: tax_engine_v2 rollout set 100% -> 10% (the previous rollout level).
- 14:31: checkout-web error rate 0.4%; payments-api error rate 0.3%; payments p99 450 ms.
- 14:38: status page update: identified (SEV1).
- 14:40:30: status page update: mitigated (SEV1), after metrics held under 1% for about 8 minutes.
- 14:41: alerts alt_31 and alt_32 cleared. Only alt_33 (search-api warning) remains.

## Root cause
Feature flag change **flg_2210** ramped `tax_engine_v2` to 100% of checkout traffic. That sent all checkout tax quotes to tax-service `/v2/quote`, which could not absorb the load. Tax-service then shed load and exhausted its worker pool. payments-api saw 3 s timeouts and returned 502 on `/charge`, and checkout-web surfaced those as 5xx. The logs in payments-api and tax-service and the metric onset all line up with the 14:02 change.

## Mitigation
Set `tax_engine_v2` rollout from 100% to 10% (the flag's previous level). Chosen over a deploy rollback because the flag is the change that introduced the fault and the runbook prefers the flag. The flag was not set to 0%, so the 10% canary remains active. Re-ramping is blocked until the payments and tax-platform teams confirm capacity.

## Verification
- checkout-web error rate: 17.6% -> 0.4% (confirmed 14:31 and 14:39).
- payments-api error rate: 18.3% -> 0.3% (confirmed 14:32 and 14:40).
- payments-api p99: 3150 ms -> 450 ms (confirmed 14:33; baseline ~420 ms).
- alt_31 and alt_32 cleared by 14:41. alt_33 (search-api warning) remains; it is not on the failure path.
- Recovery verified: yes, for error rate and latency. The 10% canary is still in place.

## Follow-ups
1. payments: review why the 10% -> 100% ramp was approved and what gate applied. Add a tax-service capacity check before any ramp. Decide when to re-ramp.
2. tax-platform: check worker pool sizing and load shedding for `/v2/quote`. Review cfg_0412 (DB pool 50 -> 80) for side effects.
3. search-api: follow up on the small latency rise after dep_7790 (warning only, no errors). alt_33 is still firing.
4. Add an alert on tax-service `/v2/quote` saturation.

## Teams paged
- payments (high): flag flg_2210 and revert details.
- tax-platform (high): tax-service saturation.
- storefront (low): FYI on checkout-web impact.

- 14:40:30 UTC: mitigated (SEV1), posted after metrics confirmed recovery.
